description: Hooks that run when the container starts or before it stops. Does **not** apply to `initContainers`. See [lifecycle](/truecharts-common/container/lifecycle).

type.description: Type of the hook. `exec` runs `command`, `http` and `https` send a GET request.

command.description: Command to run, for `type: exec`. Supports Helm `tpl`.

port.description: Port of the request, for `type: http` and `https`. Supports Helm `tpl`.

path.description: Path of the request, for `type: http` and `https`. Supports Helm `tpl`.

host.description: Host of the request, for `type: http` and `https`. Supports Helm `tpl`.

httpHeaders.description: Headers of the request, keyed by name, for `type: http` and `https`. Supports Helm `tpl`.

preStop.description: Hook that runs before the container is stopped, before it receives SIGTERM.

type.description: Type of the hook. `exec` runs `command`, `http` and `https` send a GET request.

command.description: Command to run, for `type: exec`. Supports Helm `tpl`.

port.description: Port of the request, for `type: http` and `https`. Supports Helm `tpl`.

path.description: Path of the request, for `type: http` and `https`. Supports Helm `tpl`.

host.description: Host of the request, for `type: http` and `https`. Supports Helm `tpl`.

httpHeaders.description: Headers of the request, keyed by name, for `type: http` and `https`. Supports Helm `tpl`.

postStart.description: Hook that runs right after the container is created. The container is not marked as running until it completes.
